target_description: OR room turnover time in minutes between consecutive cases. The prediction field is the rule's coefficient: positive values indicate association with longer turnovers, negative with shorter. Trained on filtered dataset excluding endoscopy suites, low-volume ORs, and WILH OR Gastroenterology cases.

rules.plain_english: Cases in Room That Day > 2 & back-to-back cases by the same surgeon & for Urology or Vascular Surgery cases

rules.rule: Case_SurgeonService > 15.5 & Turnover_Maxnumofcasesinroom > 2.5 & Case_SurgeonService <= 29.5 & Loc_ORGrp2 <= 3.5 & Turnover_NextCaseSameSurgeon > 0.5 & Case_ASACode <= 2.5 & Turnover_Maxnumofcasesinroom <= 6.5
rules.plain_english: for mid-range service lines & Cases in Room That Day between 3 and 6 & at locations other than VORH OR or WILH OR & back-to-back cases by the same surgeon & for lower acuity patients (ASA 1-3)
back-to-back cases by the same surgeon & Cases in Room That Day > 3 & Scheduled Duration > 27

rules.rule: Turnover_Maxnumofcasesinroom > 2.5 & Case_SurgeonService <= 29.5 & Case_SurgeonService <= 15.5 & Turnover_NextCaseSameSurgeon > 0.5 & Case_ASACode <= 2.5 & Turnover_Maxnumofcasesinroom <= 6.5
rules.plain_english: Cases in Room That Day between 3 and 6 & for all other service lines & for all other service lines & back-to-back cases by the same surgeon & for lower acuity patients (ASA 1-3)
exactly 4 cases in room & Scheduled Duration ≤ 237 & back-to-back cases by the same surgeon & for lower acuity patients (ASA 1-3)
